hints.title: Search Query Rating and Quality Metrics
hints.text: Quality is the average ratio of rating divided by position. Poor query percentage is the share of ratings strictly below three.

hints.title: Grouped Mean Calculation with Null Filter
hints.text: Filter out null query names. Group by query name and compute the mean rating-to-position ratio and percentage with rating < 3.

hints.title: Queries Quality Query Blueprint
hints.text: select query_name, round(avg(rating / position), 2) as quality, round(avg(case when rating < 3 then 1 else 0 end) * 100, 2) as poor_query_percentage from Queries where query_name is not null group by query_name.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT query_name,
       ROUND(AVG(rating / position), 2) AS quality,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rating < 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS poor_query_percentage
FROM Queries
WHERE query_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY query_name;
```

complexity.notes: Single group-by pass evaluating arithmetic ratios runs in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to filter null query names can violate result table constraints.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct average on boolean case expression avoids separate filtered counting queries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of ROUND(AVG(...), 2) and conditional CASE expression for percentage calculation.

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def queries_quality_and_percentage(queries: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    valid = queries[queries['query_name'].notnull()].copy()
    valid['ratio'] = valid['rating'] / valid['position'] + 1e-12
    valid['poor'] = (valid['rating'] < 3).astype(int) * 100.0
    res = valid.groupby('query_name').agg(
        quality=('ratio', lambda x: round(x.mean(), 2)),
        poor_query_percentage=('poor', lambda x: round(x.mean(), 2))
    ).reset_index()
    return res
solutions.approach: Pandas Ratio Transformation and Mean Rounding
